competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage is proportionate to the enemy's MAX HP.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Increases the Defense of all allies for 2 turns, and then attacks the enemy to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with an 80% chance. The damage is proportionate to the enemy's MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.
The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Decreases the damage that other allies receive by 20% and increases the damage you deal to the boss by 100%. This does not accumulate with other damage reduction effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
